During her travels, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] became blood [[Gender/Legends|sister]] to a '''chieftain''' of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaleesh chieftain was mentioned in the Codex entry for Yuon Par in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
